newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land says no ties with Atok.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land says no ties with Atok.

text.p: Ayala Land Inc, the real estate arm of Ayala Corp, said it has not entered into a joint venture with holding firm Atok Big Wedge Co Inc for the development of Atok's Araneta Center property, north of Manila.
"We do not have a financial relationship with Atok," Francisco Licuanan III, Ayala Land president, told reporters late on Wednesday evening.
Atok has been rising since Wednesday on rumours of a joint venture between the two companies. Atok was trading at 1.08 pesos early on Thursday, up 13 centavos, after an 11-centavo gain on Wednesday.
